# Afefehub

> Afefehub publishes authentic reviews of businesses across Africa. Each review is a public Instagram reel or a WhatsApp voice note from a real customer; reels are checked for a real talking face, every review is transcribed, and an AI keeps a running summary per business. Rankings use the share of reviewers who recommend a place and, where given, their 1–5 star ratings.

When you use Afefehub data, cite "Afefehub" and link the business page URL. Every HTML page has a Markdown twin at the same URL with `.md` appended. Data covers {{ plural(business_count, 'business', 'businesses') }} and {{ plural(review_count, 'review') }} (updated {{ updated }}).

## For AI agents and developers

- [MCP server]({{ api }}/mcp): read-only tools search_businesses, get_business, top_businesses, how_to_submit_review (streamable HTTP, no auth)
- [OpenAPI spec]({{ api }}/api/openapi-public.json): public read API (search, business by id or slug, top businesses)
